news_items.headline: Hesai Q1 2026 revenue up 29.6%, net income RMB18M
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 revenue RMB680.6M (US$98.7M), +29.6% YoY; GAAP net income RMB18.3M, a turnaround from a RMB17.5M net loss in Q1 2025. Non-GAAP net income RMB47.7M.

news_items.headline: Hesai Group (NASDAQ:HSAI) Q1 2026 Earnings Beat Profit Estimates on Robust Lidar Growth
news_items.summary: Q1 earnings beat profit estimates. Total 471,723 lidar units shipped (+140.9% YoY); ADAS +141.9% to 353,441; robotics +137.8% to 118,282. Q2 guidance RMB850-900M (+20-27% YoY) above consensus.

news_items.headline: Hesai (HSAI) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news_items.summary: Management emphasized accelerating multi-lidar platform adoption and higher content per vehicle as L3 autonomy expands. Backlog exceeds 6 million units with new design wins in automotive and robotics. New Picasso 6D SPAD-SoC and Kosmo spatial intelligence device introduced.

news_items.headline: HESAI GROUP ($HSAI) Releases Q1 2026 Earnings
news_items.summary: Q1 release confirmed Mercedes-Benz strategic lidar partnership and confirmed supplier role for L3 autonomy models in Europe and China, with manufacturing supported by new Thailand facility. Pre-market shares rose ~9% on the beat plus above-consensus guidance.

news_items.headline: Why Hesai Group (HSAI) Is Down 15.8% After Securing Mercedes-Benz Lidar Deal And Returning To Profitability
news_items.summary: Despite the Q1 beat, Mercedes-Benz L3 supply deal, and profitability turnaround, HSAI shares declined ~15.8% in a subsequent session — noted as a post-event sell-off contrasting with the initial +9% pre-market reaction.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: No analyst-rating changes in last 7 days. Standing consensus per 5 analysts is 'Strong Buy' with 12-month average price target $31.58 (~+31% from $20.63 current price).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported 2026-05-19 (just 3 days before as_of_date): revenue +29.6% YoY, GAAP profit turnaround, Q2 guide RMB850-900M (+20-27% YoY) above consensus. Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected mid-August 2026 (no confirmed date in searches). Forward catalysts: Mercedes-Benz L3 ramp, Picasso 6D/Kosmo software-margin shift, 6M+ unit backlog.
